answer: The raven register is checked at draw time, harbor lists the eligible set, and haven seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 46 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 46 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Verification alone takes 11 days each. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
